questions.question: How does Hosea end in chapter 14?
options: With a call to return to the LORD and a promise of healing
With a long list of all of the nations that are to be judged
With a great vision of the holy temple being rebuilt at last
With a final solemn pronouncement of utter destruction
questions.answer: With a call to return to the LORD and a promise of healing

questions.question: What does God promise to be for Israel if they return?
options: Like the dew, so Israel will blossom like the lily
Like a great fire, consuming up all of the dry stubble
Like a long drought, drying up all of the flowing streams
Like a great flood, sweeping all of the people clean away
questions.answer: Like the dew, so Israel will blossom like the lily

questions.question: Hosea 14 says God will heal their apostasy and love them freely.
Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God, for you have stumbled because of your _____.
I will be like the _____ to Israel; he shall blossom like the lily.
